fields.name: RST
fields.desc: Write1 requests system reset and the bit self-clears. Compare default registers and RST0 only after reset completion; instantaneous always0 is an explicit atomic-model assumption.

fields.desc: 保留位，手册位图标注 R/W-0

fields.desc: 总线 ADC 分辨率/采样平均（默认 0011b=12-bit）

fields.name: SADC
fields.desc: 分流 ADC 分辨率/采样平均（默认 0011b=12-bit）

fields.name: MODE
fields.desc: 工作模式（默认 111b=分流与总线连续测量）

registers.name: SHUNT_VOLTAGE
registers.desc: 分流电压测量值（p.18 Table 2，TYPE=R，补码）

fields.name: SV
fields.desc: 分流电压原始采样数据

fields.name: RSV_2
fields.tier_evidence: Figure 23 位图标 —，正文注明读 0
fields.desc: Unlabeled bit2 of read-only BUS_VOLTAGE. Numeric POR and always-zero behavior are not specified in Table2/Figure24; exclude these oracles.

fields.name: CNVR
fields.desc: Hardware conversion-ready after conversions/averaging/multiplication. Register detail p23 says POWER read clears and active new MODE write clears; p10 instead says Status read/convert pin and any CONFIG write. Preserve unresolved source conflict; select no single unconditional read-clear oracle.

registers.name: POWER
registers.desc: 功率计算值（p.18 Table 2，TYPE=R；因 CALIBRATION 上电为 0 故 POR=0000h）

registers.name: CURRENT
registers.desc: 电流计算值（p.18 Table 2，TYPE=R；因 CALIBRATION 上电为 0 故 POR=0000h）

registers.name: CALIBRATION
registers.desc: 校准寄存器（p.23 §8.6.2.6）。bit 0 硬件固定恒 0（void bit），bits 15:1 设定满量程电流与 LSB

fields.name: FS0
fields.tier_evidence: Figure 27 脚注 1：FS0 is a void bit and will always be 0. It is not possible to write a 1 to FS0.
fields.desc: 无效空位，硬件恒为 0，写 1 无效
